steps.caption: A location's Insights
steps.narration: Open a linked location. It opens on Insights, the performance report Google shares for it.

steps.caption: Collapse the sub-menu
steps.narration: Collapse the sub-menu to give the table more room.

steps.caption: Google performance
steps.narration: Google performance: values reported by Google, for a verified listing.

steps.caption: Views, clicks, calls, directions
steps.narration: Maps and Search views, split by desktop and mobile, then website clicks and call clicks.

steps.caption: The Total row
steps.narration: The Total row sums the whole range.

steps.selector: [data-testid="table-performance"] tr:has(span[title="Google reports with a delay of a few days"])
steps.caption: Not final yet
steps.narration: The newest day is marked not final yet. Google still corrects it, and the next sync re-reads it.

steps.caption: By month
steps.narration: Or by month, for the long view.

steps.caption: The range
steps.narration: The range runs from the last thirty days to all stored history.

steps.caption: Kept past Google's window
steps.narration: Google keeps about eighteen months. ConstructHUB keeps every day it syncs, so your history grows past that.

steps.caption: Every synced day stays
steps.narration: Every day that has synced stays in this table.

steps.caption: Menu: Locations
steps.narration: You'll find Locations in the Google Business menu on the left.

youtube.title: How to read your Google performance figures | ConstructHUB
youtube.description: The Insights tab of a linked location in ConstructHUB: the performance report Google shares for a verified listing. Maps and Search views on desktop and mobile, website clicks, call clicks and direction requests, grouped by day, week or month, from the last 30 days to all stored history. Every synced day stays, so the history keeps growing.
